youtube.title: Pac-Man's First Name Had to Be Changed 🟡 #shorts
youtube.description:
Pac-Man launched in Japan in 1980 as "Puck Man" – from "paku paku", the Japanese sound for munching. When Midway brought it to the US, the name was changed to Pac-Man, because people feared vandals would scratch the P on the cabinets into an F.

beats.text: Pac-Man was not born Pac-Man. His first name was a problem.
One single letter could be scratched into a very rude word.
In Japan, in nineteen eighty, the game was called Puck Man.
It came from paku paku, the Japanese sound of munching.
But in America, a P turns into an F with one scratch.
So before it crossed the ocean, Puck Man became Pac-Man.
And that is why Pac-Man was not born Pac-Man.
